newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DSM says Curver unit to close French plant.
newsitem.headline: DSM says Curver unit to close French plant.

text.p: Dutch chemicals group DSM NV said on Friday its Curver subsidiary would close down its manufacturing plant in Amiens, France, as part of its drive to slim down the plastic household products unit.

"Curver...is continuing the restructuring of its European production activities started last year. Within (this) framework ...there are plans to end the production activities in Amiens, France," DSM said in a statement.

It said the plans to end the Amiens-based manufacturing operations were prompted by their poor prospects compared with other Curver production facilities in the Netherlands, Britain, Hungary and Spain.
Shifts in European consumer spending patterns resulting in price pressure and falling margins for plastic household goods were an important factor driving the slim-down, it said.
DSM said Curver's French distribution, marketing and sales activities in Amiens would continue.
The effect of the closure on jobs was not yet known, DSM added.
Curver manufactures plastic household goods and garden furniture and turns over some 450 million guilders annually.
